notes.title: Release A Tale for Anna!
notes.content:
[b]Hooray! A Tale for Anna is now available on Steam![/b] ☀️

It's a colorful hidden object game based on bedtime stories the author of A Tale for Anna told his daughter Anna. It is full of original and tricky puzzles, exciting adventures and endearing characters:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521930/A_Tale_for_Anna/

A Tale for Anna will show you a mysterious world full of puzzles, magical creatures, and secrets. Enter a kingdom of enchantment and wonder as you learn the story of young Anna – the last remaining sorceress in the kingdom.

Explore fascinating worlds with Anna now 🌠

notes.title: Release date reveal!
notes.content:
We're excited to reveal the A Tale for Anna release date!

In 8 days, [b]on September 28th[/b], an incredible adventure filled with magic and fairy tales will find you and your faithful friend, a cute cat Tail.

Explore enchanted worlds together with Anna, solve addicting puzzles and stop the Queen!

[previewyoutube=uvFLPT-wJH8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Try out A Tale For Anna demo!
notes.content:
Explore and play hundreds of game demos, watch developer livestreams, and chat with the teams about their games in progress during the Steam Next Fest from June 16 to June 22. We are happy to present the magical game A Tale for Anna, in which you will embark on an exciting adventure full of miracles and wonders.

Discover enchanted worlds, add the game to your wishlist, and don't miss the release!
